children.name: Subheadline
children.text: Open-source, self-hosted, and built on CRDs plus an operator — kubectl and the dashboard always agree. Scale from a k3s homelab to a production cluster.

children.name: Helper
children.text: Issues and PRs welcome — pre-v1 software, expect rough edges.

children.name: text
children.text: Everything you need to operate game servers on Kubernetes

children.name: text
children.text: From provisioning to backups, RBAC to observability — the full operational lifecycle, in one panel.

children.name: text
children.text: Nine purpose-built CRDs — GameServer, GameTemplate, Cluster, Backup, BackupSchedule, Restore, Module, ModuleSource, and NetworkCapture — reconciled by one operator. kubectl apply and the dashboard always agree.

children.name: text
children.text: The same operational model runs on a single-node k3s cluster or a multi-node production cluster — no rearchitecting required.

children.name: text
children.text: Streams the console over WebSocket and speaks each game's native protocol — Source RCON, telnet, Rust WebRcon, BattlEye, or a REST admin API — straight from the browser.

children.name: text
children.text: Browse, edit, upload, and download server files from the dashboard with a built-in Monaco editor.

children.name: text
children.text: Scheduled or on-demand restic-backed snapshots to any S3-compatible storage, with one-click restore.

children.name: text
children.text: Versioned templates distributed as OCI bundles. Twenty-nine games ship out of the box — bring your own game via the template format.

children.name: text
children.text: Local accounts or OIDC (Keycloak, Authentik, Google, Okta, Entra ID), three built-in roles, namespace-scoped authorization.

children.name: text
children.text: Every mutating request is logged and exportable. Prometheus metrics, a Grafana dashboard, and alerting rules included.

children.name: text
children.text: Gameplane ships as a Helm chart, published as an OCI artifact. Point it at your cluster and you're running in minutes.

children.name: text
children.text: GitOps-friendly — apply the CRDs directly with kubectl apply -f if you prefer plain manifests.
